rule: b = 1 + largest lag with |acf| > 2/sqrt(n), capped at 5% of n
inputs: autocorrelation of the zero-signal paired statistic; no rejection rate consulted
reason: bets overlap in time because holding periods exceed the entry spacing, so the paired statistic is serially dependent; the dependence horizon is the largest lag whose autocorrelation exceeds the white-noise band, and the block must span it
